g.text: Same network and data as the bit-flip figure (5 126 parameters). Weights quantised symmetrically, biases and activations kept in 32-bit floating point. QAT: 12
epochs of fine-tuning with quantised weights in the forward pass (straight-through estimator). Pruning: global magnitude threshold, then 10 epochs of fine-tuning
with the mask fixed. Sizes include biases and one scale per neuron.
